standard: yEnc Control Lines Encryption Standard v1.2
note: Control-line layer only: the single-line and multi-line vectors (including control-vec-04 and control-vec-05) are FF1-primitive fixtures. Their data lines are opaque filler, their =yencryption tags are not authenticated, and single-line fixture contents (such as control-vec-04's mismatched =yencryption salt or control-vec-05's CRC-less =yend) do not by themselves satisfy combined-mode article rules, so no consumer can authenticate these articles end to end; body-level vectors live in body_encryption.json.

vectors.description: Header line 1 single-part =ybegin with 20-byte prepended bootstrap expansion
Header line 1 multipart =ybegin with 20-byte prepended bootstrap expansion

FF1-primitive fixture (control-line layer only; not a combined-mode-valid article: its =yencryption salt does not match the fixture Line 1 bootstrap salt, so dual-bootstrap agreement fails): Header line 3 =yencryption (exact length preservation)
FF1-primitive fixture (control-line layer only; not a combined-mode-valid article: its =yend carries no applicable ciphertext CRC): Footer line 4 =yend minimal (exact length preservation)
Footer line 54 =yend multipart with pcrc32 (exact length preservation)

FF1 line-restoration vector, 5-line single-part layout (control-line layer only; data lines opaque, tag not authenticated): =ybegin, =yencryption header (line 2), two data lines untouched, =yend (line 5); line 1 bootstrap expansion
FF1 line-restoration vector, 54-line multipart layout (control-line layer only; data lines opaque, tag not authenticated): verifies physical line counting 1..54 across header, data, and footer
One-byte data fixture: single data byte passes through untouched; no trial decryption occurs

FF1 line-restoration vector, exact-wrap layout (control-line layer only; data lines opaque, tag not authenticated): data lines exactly one yEnc wrap long pass through untouched, after an =yencryption header at line 2
FF1 line-restoration vector, combined-mode multipart layout (control-line layer only; data lines opaque, tag not authenticated): deterministic header positions (1..3), one-byte data line untouched
Single-part article whose =ybegin name contains '=ypart ' and 'part=': physical line 2 (not strings in =ybegin name=) governs layout, so the layout is single-part (=yencryption at line 2, D = 3)
